title: A Confession for the Cipher
author: Elodie Thackeray
blurb: Isandro Winterbourne, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
